capabilities: enter a full-screen writing mode that hides all Obsidian UI
generate personalized blog post topics from your profile and GitHub repositories
auto-save each session as a date-stamped note with the prompt as a blockquote
choose between Anthropic and OpenAI providers with your own API key
disambiguation: The AI only generates blog post topic prompts; it does not write, edit, or chat about your text.
extras: Requires Obsidian 1.11.4+ for secret storage. Each session makes one public (unauthenticated) GitHub API request and one billed AI provider request; the 300-token prompt cap keeps cost to fractions of a cent per session. Sessions default to an output folder named Muse/. Manifest notes the plugin has not been manually reviewed by Obsidian staff.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in focus mode for drafting, and writers often stall deciding what to write about; Muse combines both by supplying a concrete topic before each session.
summary: Distraction-free full-screen writing mode that generates personalized blog post topic prompts via Anthropic or OpenAI.
